card.name: Decimal point in section numbers
card.fires_on: The period after a section number such as 5 or 2 when it starts the subsection number 5.1 or 2.1 in a drug label's full text. It follows the highlights list of cross-references like (5.3).

modes.label: Warnings subsection 5.1
modes.description: The period in 5.1 that opens the first warnings subsection after the highlights list.
modes.example: ( 5.3 ) 5<<.>>1 Increased Bleeding Time With some NSA

modes.label: Dosage subsection 2.1
modes.description: The period in 2.1 that opens the first dosage and administration subsection.

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so the model is set to write the subsection number after the period, mostly 1 and similar digits.
card.plain: It marks the dot in a section number like 5.1, where a digit comes next.
